title: Valid Palindrome
hints: Start one pointer at each end. What should happen when a pointer lands on a space or punctuation mark?
Move `i` forward past non-alphanumeric characters and `j` backward past them. Compare `s[i].lower()` with `s[j].lower()`; if they differ, it is not a palindrome.
Reversing a list in place uses the same two pointers: swap `a[i]` and `a[j]`, then move both towards the middle.

args: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
